list.label: Publisher
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT publisher FROM serving.fact_article ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT publisher FROM serving.fact_article ORDER BY 1

list.name: content_class
list.label: Content class
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT content_class FROM serving.dim_article_type WHERE article_type_sk <> -1 ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT content_class FROM serving.dim_article_type WHERE article_type_sk <> -1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Scholarly articles
panels.description: How many known-type scholarly articles are in the selected publisher's current corpus?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS scholarly_articles
FROM serving.fact_article f
JOIN serving.dim_article_type at ON at.article_type_sk = f.article_type_sk
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND at.is_scholarly
  AND at.article_type_sk <> -1

panels.title: Journals
panels.description: How many known journals have at least one article for this publisher?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT jc.journal_url) AS journals
FROM serving.fact_article f
JOIN serving.dim_journal j ON j.journal_sk = f.journal_sk
JOIN serving.dim_journal jc ON jc.publisher = j.publisher
                           AND jc.journal_url = j.journal_url
                           AND jc.is_current
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND f.journal_sk <> -1

panels.title: Authors (scholarly)
panels.description: How many distinct known authors contributed to scholarly articles?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.author_sk) AS authors
FROM serving.fact_article f
JOIN serving.dim_article_type at ON at.article_type_sk = f.article_type_sk
JOIN serving.bridge_article_author b ON b.article_sk = f.article_sk
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND at.is_scholarly
  AND at.article_type_sk <> -1
  AND b.role = 'author'
  AND b.author_sk <> -1

panels.title: CC-licensed share (scholarly)
panels.description: What share of scholarly articles has a Creative Commons license?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.has_cc_license) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric,
  2
) AS cc_share
FROM serving.fact_article f
JOIN serving.dim_article_type at ON at.article_type_sk = f.article_type_sk
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND at.is_scholarly
  AND at.article_type_sk <> -1

panels.title: Articles per journal by content class
panels.description: How does each current journal's article count break down by content class?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT jc.journal_title AS journal,
       at.content_class,
       COUNT(*) AS articles
FROM serving.fact_article f
JOIN serving.dim_journal j ON j.journal_sk = f.journal_sk
JOIN serving.dim_journal jc ON jc.publisher = j.publisher
                           AND jc.journal_url = j.journal_url
                           AND jc.is_current
JOIN serving.dim_article_type at ON at.article_type_sk = f.article_type_sk
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND f.journal_sk <> -1
  AND at.article_type_sk <> -1
  AND at.content_class IN (${content_class:sqlstring})
GROUP BY jc.journal_title, at.content_class
ORDER BY jc.journal_title, at.content_class

panels.title: Scholarly articles per publication month
panels.description: How many scholarly articles fall in each known publication month, including future months?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(d.date, 'YYYY-MM') AS publication_month,
       COUNT(*) AS articles
FROM serving.fact_article f
JOIN serving.dim_article_type at ON at.article_type_sk = f.article_type_sk
JOIN serving.dim_date d ON d.date_sk = f.pub_month_date_sk
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND at.is_scholarly
  AND at.article_type_sk <> -1
  AND f.pub_month_date_sk <> -1
GROUP BY to_char(d.date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY publication_month

panels.title: Scholarly articles with unknown publication month
panels.description: How many scholarly articles lack a publication month, as can happen with book-series records?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unknown_publication_month
FROM serving.fact_article f
JOIN serving.dim_article_type at ON at.article_type_sk = f.article_type_sk
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND at.is_scholarly
  AND at.article_type_sk <> -1
  AND f.pub_month_date_sk = -1

panels.title: Top authors (weighted)
panels.description: Which scholarly authors lead after each coauthored article is split by its author weights?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name,
       ROUND(SUM(b.weight)::numeric, 2) AS weighted_articles,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.article_sk) AS article_count
FROM serving.fact_article f
JOIN serving.dim_article_type at ON at.article_type_sk = f.article_type_sk
JOIN serving.bridge_article_author b ON b.article_sk = f.article_sk
JOIN serving.dim_author a ON a.author_sk = b.author_sk
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND at.is_scholarly
  AND at.article_type_sk <> -1
  AND b.role = 'author'
  AND b.author_sk <> -1
GROUP BY b.author_sk, a.display_name
ORDER BY weighted_articles DESC, article_count DESC, a.display_name
LIMIT 15

panels.title: CC-licensed share by journal (scholarly)
panels.description: What share of each known journal's scholarly articles has a Creative Commons license?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT jc.journal_title AS journal,
       ROUND(
         (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.has_cc_license) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric,
         2
       ) AS cc_share
FROM serving.fact_article f
JOIN serving.dim_journal j ON j.journal_sk = f.journal_sk
JOIN serving.dim_journal jc ON jc.publisher = j.publisher
                           AND jc.journal_url = j.journal_url
                           AND jc.is_current
JOIN serving.dim_article_type at ON at.article_type_sk = f.article_type_sk
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND at.is_scholarly
  AND at.article_type_sk <> -1
  AND f.journal_sk <> -1
GROUP BY jc.journal_title
ORDER BY cc_share DESC, jc.journal_title

panels.title: Classification review
panels.description: Which non-scholarly articles need a closer look at their source classification?

panels.title: Non-scholarly articles
panels.description: Which non-scholarly articles and source types are present under each journal's current title?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT jc.journal_title,
       at.article_type_key,
       at.content_class,
       f.english_title,
       f.doi
FROM serving.fact_article f
JOIN serving.dim_journal j ON j.journal_sk = f.journal_sk
JOIN serving.dim_journal jc ON jc.publisher = j.publisher
                           AND jc.journal_url = j.journal_url
                           AND jc.is_current
JOIN serving.dim_article_type at ON at.article_type_sk = f.article_type_sk
WHERE f.publisher IN (${publisher:sqlstring})
  AND NOT at.is_scholarly
ORDER BY at.content_class, at.article_type_key, jc.journal_title, f.english_title
